evidence: Matches 'Build system' label and touches contrib/guix/libexec/codesign.sh, which is part of the Guix release tooling.
rationale: Fixes codesigning archive extraction failures when running `guix-codesign` inside root container environments. The PR resolves `Cannot change ownership to uid 0, gid 0: Invalid argument` errors by aligning `codesign.sh` with the `--no-same-owner` flag previously added to `build.sh` in #34550.
